theorems.name: Submission.dsmc_approxTangentPlane_subset_tangentSpace
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n r d : ℕ) (M N : Set (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), 1 ≤ r → IsEmbeddedSubmanifold r d N → x ∈ N → μHE[n] (M \ N) = 0 → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q → (Q : Set (Euclid P)) ⊆ tangentSpace N x
